name: Pasadena Independent School District
districtFact: Pasadena ISD serves 48,650 students in grades PK–12. Its boundaries include most of Pasadena, South Houston, part of Houston including Genoa, and part of Pearland.

about.title: About Pasadena ISD
about.content: Pasadena Independent School District serves 48,650 students across 69 schools. The district includes most of Pasadena, South Houston, part of Houston including Genoa, and part of Pearland.

about.title: District and Campus Dates
about.content: Use the district calendar for school-year dates and districtwide schedule changes. Check the assigned campus for testing, athletics, ceremonies, dismissal times, and other school-specific events.

planningTips.title: Before Using the Calendar
content: Use the calendar for the specific school year your student will attend.
Confirm dismissal times, testing, athletics, and ceremonies with the assigned campus.
Check Pasadena ISD announcements for emergency closures and same-day schedule changes.
